translations.web: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
translations.bsb: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
translations.kjv: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
translations.asv: O praise Jehovah, all ye nations; Laud him, all ye peoples.
